العمل الذي يتعين القيام به
Unless the turbine shows an abnormal behavior in 
operation or during the periodic test (e.g. pressure and temperature changes in 
the impulse chamber, bearing oil and metal temperature changes, vibration 
amplitude changes, etc) the following 
maintenance program is recommended.
Inspection of Steam Valves
Check 
 the liquid penetrant or inspect the magnetic particle of HP stop valve body 
 welding
Check the liquid penetrant or 
 inspect the magnetic 
 particle of valve stem.
Inspect the liquid penetrant of Stellite inserted on valve plug 
 and seat.
Check the stem bushing clearances.
Check the stem for straightness.
Inspect the filters.
Inspect the liquid penetrant of valve cover studs.
Check 
 the liquid penetrant or inspect the magnetic particle of HP stop valve body 
 welding
Check the liquid penetrant or 
 inspect the magnetic 
 particle of valve stem.
Inspect the liquid penetrant of Stellite inserted on valve plug 
 and seat.
Check the stem bushing clearances.
Check the stem for straightness.
Inspect the filters.
Inspect the liquid penetrant of valve cover studs.
Inspect the Servomotors
Disassembly and inspection of the servomotors are 
 included in the overhaul program of the valves.
Wherever possible without removing cylinder covers, inspect outer glands.
Maintenance of Oil System
Test the water and clean the cooler water 
 side.
Empty and 
 clean the oil reservoirs

 clean the oil reservoirs
